strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% bla ḍṣb
strings.seo.why[0].text: Ur yelli usmel, ur yelli tayssa n ubutun, ur yelli abazur ittwarun ɣ isɣzaf n k.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Ur tskcmḍ s tansa
strings.seo.why[1].text: Ur yelli uziṭṭaf ara tskcmeḍ: ldi tasniwt, sers isɣzaf n k, tewjed.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Isɣzaf n k ttwaqqnen i kecc
strings.seo.why[2].text: Ttwaskarn, sakin ttwkkasn zund tura. Ur nettuṭṭef isɣzaf n k neɣ isefka n k.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Tasniwt takwawt
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, twlafin, EPUB… seg usɣwas neɣ tiliɣrit.
strings.seo.faq[0].q: Waxxa d tidet pdff bla ḍṣb?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Ih. Yal amass bla ḍṣb, ur yelli abazur d wacemma ittwasudfen ddaw usmel. Ur nettnadi tayssa n ubutun.
strings.seo.faq[1].q: Illa ma iqqanen ad sskreɣ uziṭṭaf?
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Uhu. Ur tskcmḍ s tansa, ur yelli tansa n imayl: tesseqdadeḍ imassen zund tura.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Uhu. Isɣzaf n k ttwseqdaden ɣas i twuri tseqsadeḍ, sakin ttwkkasn. Ur ten-yeqqeṛ yiwen ur ten-yettrazu.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Ih. pdff itteddu ɣ tiliɣrit n yal tiliɣrit, tasniwt neɣ usɣwas (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), bla ma tesbeddeḍ acemma.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, twlafin (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML d wiyyaḍ.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Tzemreḍ ad tesseqdadeḍ alamma d {files} n isɣzaf s tikelt, d usɣzaf ittwasnulfan izmer ad yesɛu alamma d {pages} n tsmatin.
strings.privacy.title: Tinfaliyin
strings.privacy.description: Mek issefti pdff isɣzaf n k: ur yelli uziṭṭaf, ur yelli usɣzaf ittuṭṭfen, ur yelli imnayen d usnegmi n isefka.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff ittwanfa afad isɣzaf n k ad qqnen i kecc. Dagi, s wawal aɣezfan, acu iyeḍran mi tesseqdadeḍ.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Isɣzaf n k
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ttwazznan s ubaɛuḍ (HTTPS), ttwaskarn s wudm awurman, sakin ttwkkasn zund tura mi tewjed tawuri. Isɣzaf imeqqranen tteddun s usenɣms anawur s yisem amazzal d ttwkkasn zund tura mi tkfa twuri; asgaddud awurman yekkes kra illan deg 24 n wussan.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Ur yelli uziṭṭaf, ur yelli isefka n wiyyaḍ
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff ur yessuter uziṭṭaf, ur yelli tansa n imayl d ur yelli tayssa n ubutun. Isɣzaf n k ur ttwaraɛen, ur ttwazrawen, ur ttwazznan neɣ ur ttwseqdaden ad snernin tasnatnawt.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Asɣel n imnayen
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Nettagi ismlal s wudm amggan d bla ikukiyen (Vercel Web Analytics) afad ad nessen anwi imassen iyesseftrn. Ur yelli imnayen, ur yelli uḍfaṛ.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Ikukiyen
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Akuki yan, yezmer ad yili: ittmekta taseklant tferneḍ.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Aselkim
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Asmel ittwasegma s Vercel deg iselkimn n Paris; isenfalen n Word, Excel d PowerPoint ttwasegman s Render deg Frankfurt. Imeskar ad tesseqdaden isɣzaf ɣas deg wakud n usenfel.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Msahel
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Asteqsi neɣ awal? Msahel-aneɣ seg tasniwt n usenfar:

strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Sdduk isɣzaf n PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint d twlafin ɣ yan PDF, s umhaz tesseqdadeḍ. Bla ḍṣb, ur tskcmḍ s tansa, ur yelli abazur, isɣzaf ttwkkasn zund tura.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Sersi isɣzaf n k akkʷ ɣ yan usɣzaf: pdff yessefti PDF, d daɣ isɣzaf n Word, tifelwin n Excel, tiywsiwin d twlafin, d yesddukn-ten ɣ yan PDF zeddigen s usnmel i yal usɣzaf.

strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Uṭṭef ɣas tismatin teqqsadeḍ seg PDF, neɣ kkes tid ttwadnen. S zik, bla ḍṣb, ur tskcmḍ s tansa, ur yelli abazur.

strings.tools.organiser.intro: Tismatin ttwaskarn s ur ttnizam? Aru amhaz amaynu (amadya 3, 1, 2, 4-end) neɣ iniw usɣzaf ammatut: pdff iskar ayen iqqanen.
